title: All Fonts Pack
author: Chequered Ink
summary: Over 1200 commercial OTF and TTF font styles by Chequered Ink in one 23 MB sorted ZIP. The page documents full commercial use for small businesses and names the archive on the product page.
engineNote: The page lists Chequered Ink All Fonts Pack Sorted.zip with OTF and TTF inside. No engine project was verified; install fonts manually.
licenseNote: The page states pay-once unlimited commercial use for qualifying small businesses and links separate license terms. The archive was not downloaded.
priceNote: USD purchase panel showed $190 crossed out to $19. No paid download was made.

curation.rationale: 1200+ named font styles in one sorted ZIP with 155 ratings at 5.0 and explicit commercial terms. Value is exceptional at 90% off $190; individual font files were not audited.

title: Pixel Prototype Player Sprites
author: Dead Revolver
summary: Prototype 96x84px player rig with walk, run, combat, climbing and fishing animations. The page names PixelPrototypePlayer.zip at 3.4 MB holding the .aseprite sources, one sprite sheet and per-animation PNG frames.
engineNote: The page names a ZIP containing PNG frames and the original Aseprite files. PNG imports with manual sprite and animation setup in Unity, Godot, Unreal or GameMaker; no native engine project, rig or performance was verified.
licenseNote: The product page lists the asset license as Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal and states the files can be modified or used personally and commercially with no crediting required. The paid archive was not downloaded.
priceNote: USD purchase panel showed $9.99 crossed out to $4.99 with a 50% Off badge. The pay-once minimum for the pack is $4.99 USD; no paid file was acquired.

curation.rationale: The listing documents a 3.4 MB archive with Aseprite sources, one combined sprite sheet and per-animation PNG folders, plus 4.9/5 across 177 ratings and a long public update log. Contents are publisher-listed only; the paid archive was not opened or tested in an engine, so grades stay strong rather than exceptional.

title: Pixel UI & HUD
author: Dead Revolver
summary: Pixel interface kit whose contents sections list buttons, banners, cursors, tooltips, panels, grids, value bars, a skill tree, a minimap and style themes. Two ZIP uploads are named, a 2.5 MB kit and a 10 MB Unity demo.
engineNote: Two ZIP uploads are named: Pixel UI & HUD.zip 2.5 MB and Pixel UI & HUD - Unity Demo.zip 10 MB. The demo is a ZIP rather than a named engine package, so integration is manual in Unity, Godot, Unreal or GameMaker. A creator reply names Sprites/Panels/Blue/PanelLarge.png inside the pack.
licenseNote: The page states the kit can be modified or used personally and commercially with no crediting required, and lists Royalty Free among its tags. No separate license URL is published on the product, so the product page itself is the license evidence.
priceNote: USD purchase panel showed $4.99 crossed out to $2.49 with a 50% Off badge. The pay-once minimum is $2.49 USD and includes both listed archives; no paid file was acquired.

curation.rationale: The page documents thirteen named element groups including a skill tree, minimap and value bars, ships a separate demo archive, and holds 5.0/5 across 46 ratings. Contents remain publisher-listed; the paid ZIPs were not opened, and no engine integration or draw-call behaviour was tested.

title: 1000+ Fantasy RPG Icons
author: finalbossblues
summary: 1000+ 16-bit fantasy RPG icons in full-colour and monochrome variants across item, weapon, armour, consumable, currency and resource groups. Two ZIPs are named, 4.7 MB and 4.1 MB, plus a quick_guide.png overview.
engineNote: The FORMATS section states the set includes multiple formats for use in different engines: larger full sheets arranged for RPG Maker (32x32 for VX/Ace, 24x24 for MV) and that the full sheets should also work in most other engines and software. PNG is named through the documented quick_guide.png. Slicing sheets into engine atlases is manual work.
licenseNote: In the product's own comment thread the author answers that commercial use is OK, edits are fine, there are no engine limitations and no credit is required, pointing to the gamedevmarket Pro licence wording that permits any use except direct redistribution. The author also notes the separate Degica release carries an RPG Maker-only licence; this itch.io product does not.
priceNote: USD purchase panel showed $6.00 crossed out to $3.60 with a 40% Off badge. The pay-once minimum is $3.60 USD; no paid file was acquired.

curation.rationale: The listing documents 1000+ icons in two colour variants across named item, weapon, armour, consumable, currency, resource and faction groups, in 8.8 MB of publisher-listed archives, at 4.8/5 across 30 ratings. Value is graded exceptional because $3.60 is far below the usual price for a documented icon set of this scope; the ZIPs themselves were not opened, so quality and completeness stay at 4/5.
